title: Cosmo knows every way to add detail and upscale, and offers or picks the right one
description: Teach the in-app agent (and MCP) what each detail/upscale route does - i2i, masked Detail, model upscale (normal / Grid / Tiles, 1x tiles = detail only), the image-workspace tools (basic upscale, upscale with model) - so it picks by picture size and ask, or offers two choices when it is a judgement. Fabio's decision tree in brief.md. Rework existing rules and op notes, never stack new text on top.
